pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, medium-brown polygonal regions with moderate edge angularity. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the neck and upper torso, transitioning to smaller and more rounded shapes on the posterior flank and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming a grid-like mesh. Junction nodes are primarily tri-directional. Pixel thickness is variable, typically narrowing at junction points and widening along parallel patch edges.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane exhibiting low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the dorsal neck and shoulder hump silhouette.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A large, localized area of rugose textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation is visible on the upper shoulder/flank region, significantly altering the standard pelage pattern in that zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant localized region of thickened, crust-like tissue on the upper mid-torso, consistent with a chronic skin lesion.
